mentions.name: Local-first autonomous agent system
mentions.description: A local-first autonomous agent system running on Windows, built as an experiment to explore agent planning versus step-by-step tool-calling, how agent state drifts over long tasks, and how to make the system predictable when adding retries and recovery logic.
mentions.problem: Agent systems become unpredictable over long tasks, with state drift and fragility once retries and recovery logic are added.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm experimenting with a local-first autonomous agent system on Windows.

evidence.value: I'm experimenting with a local-first autonomous agent system on Windows.
